newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Capel cuts ICI estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Capel cuts ICI estimates.

text.p: HSBC James Capel reduced earnings estimates for Imperial Chemical Industries Plc on Wednesday.
Market sources said the downgrade took account of currency factors and was intended to bring estimates into line with consensus forecasts.
The broker's current year pretax profit estimate was cut to 355 million stg from 470 million stg and to 580 million stg from 650 million stg for the following year.
Capel maintains its "hold" recommendation, said market sources.
Shares in ICI were 10p lower at 806-1/2p by 0847 GMT.
